title: Show what moved between two measurements
description: A dumbbell joins a start and an end value, so the reader sees both the levels and the direction of change.
version: 0.0.1
styles: [scientific]
---

## Three teams improved and one slipped

These illustrative scores compare each team before and after a training programme. The hollow dot is the start, the filled dot the end, and the line between them is the change.

```chart
type: dumbbell
title: Three of four teams scored higher after training
subtitle: Score per team; hollow dot before, filled dot after
data:
  inline:
    - {team: Alpha, before: 62, after: 78}
    - {team: Beta, before: 55, after: 51}
    - {team: Gamma, before: 70, after: 88}
    - {team: Delta, before: 48, after: 66}
encoding: {x: team, lower: before, upper: after}
axes:
  y: {label: Score}
```

*Source: Illustrative values. Beta is the only team whose score fell.*

Use the keyboard or pointer to read each team's start, end and signed change.
